items.item: AJ PLAN §1: K1 pointer and the ethics sentences, dated
items.how: The Reading is re-said in two sentences pointing to 07's 'Within the whole map' for the full form. Condition 1 and 05's pools can bring a loss into what a selection reads, along coupling; the hinge needs the loss to bear on what the selector depends on, along being affected (fish, not bed). A self-concerned order ranks every widening on a listing above where the selector's own closure along being affected covers the listing, mutual dependence being one sufficient way. Dependence can also be made by domination, so closing relations of dependence is a mechanism to examine, not a criterion, and the order side is open (08 §12 item 12). The old wording is kept in a parenthesis. The ethics paragraph takes K3's short form, the anchor's definition (K6) and the persisting line's limit (K7), with a ninth-pass dated note keeping the old in-time words; the plan's header is dated.
